title: 31 Seabed Mining Claims Exist Before The World Agrees
hook: Seabed claims nearly quadrupled before the world agreed whether to dig.
closing: The ocean-floor race is advancing faster than the rules meant to govern it.
question: Should seabed mining pause?

segments.say: Seabed mining claims reached 31. The crowded race shows companies are already positioning for the ocean floor.
Seabed nodules hold 4 times the cobalt in land reserves. Battery demand makes the ocean floor valuable.
37 countries sought a mining pause. Resistance is growing almost as quickly as the claims.
